Metadata.Goal: Make runtime update/delete mutations target exactly the compiled primary-key row and fail closed when targeting facts are unavailable.
Metadata.Description: Add runtime-owned regression tests and a model-derived public Writer adapter without changing RuntimeMutation shape.

TaskSpace.name: fix-runtime-primary-key-mutation-targeting
TaskSpace.Description: Freeze the unsafe multi-row behavior in RED tests, implement model-derived targeting, and run runtime plus consumer compatibility gates.

TaskGroup.name: Primary-key targeting RED contract
TaskGroup.Description: Prove the current adapter performs an unsafe unscoped mutation and define fail-closed target semantics.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: RED failures arise from missing runtime-owned Writer targeting

Task.name: Write keyed update and delete RED tests
Task.Description: Add multi-row runtime tests for exact update/delete targeting, sibling invariance, a non-id primary key, invalid/missing key rejection before IO, and create compatibility. Do not implement the adapter.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Update and delete RED cases prove only one compiled-primary-key target is legal on multi-row state
A non-id key and missing/invalid key failure are executable without weakening storage constraints
Existing create/seed and transaction tests remain green outside the intentional RED cases

TaskGroup.name: Runtime Writer target adapter
TaskGroup.Description: Project create unchanged and update/delete with model-derived exact targeting, then verify consumers and boundaries.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: runtime and G7 focused suites pass
builds, boundaries, rollback and batch compatibility pass

Task.name: Implement fail-closed primary-key mutation targeting
Task.Description: Add an internal pure RuntimeMutation-to-Writer adapter using the compiled entity primary key. Preserve create, target update/delete by equality, reject unavailable keys before Writer IO, and run runtime/bundle tests and builds.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Update/delete target only the requested row for id and non-id primary keys while siblings stay unchanged
Missing/invalid targeting fails closed and create/seed, rollback, best-effort batch and cleanup semantics do not regress
Runtime suite, G7 IT matrix, bundle suite, builds, import guards and protected capsule manifests pass

cdt:AttractorCheck.note: Fresh review found no direction gaps: compiled model authority, pure adapter, explicit Writer effect boundary, fail-closed targeting, runtime 83/83 and G7 IT 14/14 pass. Report: reports/attractor-check-report.md.
